Two-page spread (pages 52–53) of Scott Chernoff's "Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood" in ''Star Wars Insider'' 47 (January 2000). Chernoff's article body is on the left; Shannon McRandle as Mara Jade is on the right. Used on [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]] and [[Shannon Baksa]].

Fair use of a magazine still for encyclopedia commentary on the Decipher photoshoot.
